claim: Build the 139-galaxy local formula atlas using the pilot-passed, target-blind baryonic-structure grammar. This remains a per-galaxy diagnostic atlas, not a universal gravity law.

population.order: canonical admitted exploration order from sparc_full_sample.assemble

evaluator.folds_and_admission: unchanged from G0 and the G1 pilot

checkpoint.unit: one completed galaxy with all three segments

decision.pass: all 139 galaxies have at least one CPU-FP64-admitted local formula after exactly 100 million new candidate trials each
decision.block: any galaxy remains uncovered, any segment under-runs, any checkpoint fails replay, or any confirmation access occurs
decision.after_pass: advance to G2 equivalence collapse without opening confirmation data
decision.after_block: retain uncovered galaxies and family failure cells, repair G1, and keep G2 locked
